description: This source file defines the MultipleSubscriptionConsumerGrain class, implementing an Orleans grain that manages multiple stream subscriptions, including subscribing, resuming, stopping, and tracking message counts.

classes.name: MultipleSubscriptionConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that manages multiple stream subscriptions, tracking message counts, handling activation and deactivation, and providing subscription control methods.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A private helper class that tracks the count of messages processed and errors.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a stream for consuming messages.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a previously existing stream subscription handle.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes the grain from a stream subscription.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription handles for a specified stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of current message counts per subscription.

methods.name: ClearNumberConsumed
methods.description: Clears all message counts and errors tracked.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Processes received stream items and increments message count.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles stream errors and increments error count.
